svg.title: Two cross-sections of the upper films, one above the other, cut off at the bottom. Before the step a flat pale oxide buries a metal line and a wider metal shape carrying a raised thin plate. After it a thin flat layer of the same pale oxide covers the whole top.
svg.desc: Two cross-sections of the upper films, one above the other, cut off at the bottom. Before the step a flat pale oxide buries a metal line and a wider metal shape carrying a raised thin plate. After it a thin flat layer of the same pale oxide covers the whole top.
svg.text: A thin plasma oxide is deposited on the polished surface.
After: a thin cap oxide on top
The lower part of the slice is not drawn.
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
